{{Top|leg}}
A '''swoopshaw''' was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] with its armor and [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] removed, designed for passenger transport. It could hold up to four passengers.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
